$description: Supplier iScan design tokens, light theme. Single source for the web frontend and the server-side PDF. Format: W3C Design Tokens Community Group draft ($value, $type). Aliases use {group.token}. Generated CSS custom properties are named --isc-<group>-<token> (see _docs/design/brief.md, How the tokens are consumed). Status: proposed, pending owner approval on issue #3.

paper-margin.$description: Margin note (evidence panel) and side-panel background

cobalt-tint.$description: Selected or hovered row in tables and the comparison

skeleton.$description: Loading placeholder blocks, static (decorative, carries no information)

ink.$description: Primary text, headings, strong rules, buyer-decided status labels

ink-secondary.$description: Secondary text, micro-labels, quote source lines

ink-disabled.$description: Text of disabled controls (kept at 4.5:1 or more although WCAG exempts it)

cobalt-strong.$description: Hover and pressed state of cobalt actions; visited links

on-cobalt.$description: Text on a cobalt or cobalt-strong fill (primary button)

brick.$description: RESERVED for missing evidence: 'No public evidence found' and evidence gaps. Never used for anything else

border-control.$description: Boundary of form fields and secondary buttons (UI component, 3:1)

rule.$description: Hairline separators between rows and sections (decorative)

status.$description: Semantic aliases. Evidence status (source type, missing evidence) and buyer review status are separate channels; see brief.md, Status vocabulary.

pending.$description: Awaiting the buyer: fact 'proposed', statement 'ai_draft'. Dashed border

decided.$description: Decided by the buyer: 'approved', 'corrected'. Solid border

evidence.$description: Source type and 'Redacted extract': borderless micro-label in the quote's source line

flag.$description: Profile-level flags ('identity to verify', 'partial', 'insufficient sources', 'source excluded at the site owner's request'): banner with a thick ink left rule

error.$description: Form and system errors: ink text, 2px ink border, 'Error:' prefix. Brick is not used (reserved). Pending owner decision, see brief.md

base.$description: UI and body text, table cells

h1.$description: Supplier name (Plex Serif); counts as large text

row.$description: Minimum height of a table row or fact row

control.$description: Height of buttons and single-line fields

target-min.$description: Minimum pointer target (WCAG 2.2 2.5.8, adopted as good practice)

panel.$description: Supplier card side panel width at desktop

selection.$description: Cobalt bar on the left of a selected row

section-rule.$description: Ink rule above a section title

none.$description: Default: rules, panels, tables, quotes, banners

control.$description: Buttons, fields, micro-labels, source chips. No pill shapes
